fixes.old: Rows identical means dy/dx depends only on x; columns identical means it depends only on y.
fixes.new: Rows identical (same slope all along a horizontal row) means dy/dx depends only on y; columns identical means it depends only on x.
fixes.why: Rows/columns are swapped, and the note contradicts the card's own answer.

fixes.old: Substitute an expression for x, differentiate, integrate, multiply by a power of x or a constant, and add two series. All preserve the radius of convergence.
fixes.new: Substitute an expression for x, differentiate, integrate, multiply by a power of x or a constant, and add two series. Differentiating, integrating, and multiplying by a power of x preserve the radius; substituting an expression for x changes it (solve the original condition for the new expression).
fixes.why: Substitution does not preserve the radius (e.g. 2x halves it); this contradicts the card on substitution and intervals.

fixes.old: It is where f'' changes from positive to negative, so f has a point of inflection there and is increasing most steeply. It is NOT a maximum of f.
fixes.new: It is where f'' changes from positive to negative, so f has a point of inflection there; if f' is positive there, it is also where f is increasing most steeply. It is NOT a maximum of f.
fixes.why: A relative max of f' is the steepest increase only when f' > 0 there; if f' < 0 the function is decreasing least steeply.

fixes.old: The value L that the population approaches but never exceeds as $t \to \infty$; it is the nonzero equilibrium solution where $\frac{dP}{dt} = 0$.
fixes.new: The value L that the population approaches as $t \to \infty$; it is the nonzero equilibrium solution where $\frac{dP}{dt} = 0$.
fixes.why: 'Never exceeds' is false when P(0) > L, where the population decreases toward L from above.
